title: Editorial Scrollytelling & Asymmetric Dual-Speed
discipline: Editorial Web Architecture · Dual-Speed Cognitive Pacing · Fixed Mastheads · Scrollytelling
hypothesis: Can an asymmetric dual-speed layout—anchoring massive stationary serif typography on the left while orchestrating staggered multi-plane gallery movements on the right—transcend standard web scrolling to evoke the luxurious cognitive contemplation of a high-fashion exhibition catalog?
